brief: The canvas displays a highly detailed mechanical object, rendered entirely in polished brass and styled as a 1920s Bauhaus-inspired pocket watch. The composition centers on the contrast between a delicate, superficial outer covering and the complex, organized mechanisms underneath. These internal structures—featuring visible gears, levers, and pipes—are shown in continuous, choreographed motion, giving the impression of a precisely functioning, clockwork exercise.

statement: This sketch presents a meticulously detailed mechanical pocket watch inspired by 1920s Bauhaus aesthetics. The composition explores the contrast between an elegant outer brass casing and the intricate internal mechanisms that drive its function. Through continuous animation, visible gears rotate with precise timing, levers move in choreographed patterns, and pipes pulse with subtle motion—each element contributing to a unified impression of perfectly synchronized clockwork. The viewer observes a self-contained world where mechanical elegance meets functional complexity, rendered entirely within the geometric constraints of a WebGL canvas.
